fidelity: F2a — Two-Phase Lumped Cryogenic Tank (self-pressurization + boil-off ODE)
source: Van Dresar & Stochl (1993) NASA TM-106033; Barron (1985) Cryogenic Systems 2nd ed., Oxford; Sherif et al. (1997) Int. J. Hydrogen Energy 22(7):683; Johnson (2010) NREL/TP-560-47503 (MLI k(T)); NIST Chemistry WebBook / Leachman et al. (2009) J. Phys. Chem. Ref. Data 38(3):721 (normal-H2 properties at 20 K)

m_tank.note: Empty tank structural mass (inner vessel + MLI)

cp_wall.note: Inner-wall (Al/SS) specific heat near 20-30 K; small but finite thermal mass

U_ref.note: Effective overall U at T_amb=298 K (vacuum + 30-layer perforated MLI)

T0_mli_ref.note: Reference mean-wall temperature for MLI fit

f_vapor_to_liquid.note: Fraction of heat leak reaching liquid via ullage (0 = all heat reaches liquid surface directly)

hydrogen.note: Normal-hydrogen saturated-property values near the normal boiling point (20.28 K, 1 atm). Source: NIST Chemistry WebBook; Leachman et al. (2009) reference EOS.

h_vap.note: Latent heat of vaporization at NBP

cp_liquid.note: Saturated liquid specific heat at NBP

dhvap_dT.note: Latent-heat decline with T toward critical point (NIST-derived slope near NBP)

antoine.note: Antoine-type vapor-pressure correlation for normal H2, log10(P_bar) = A - B/(T_K + C), fit to NIST saturation data 14-32 K. Barron (1985) tabulation.
